flatten_object_for_tracing: flatten a hierarchical object into a tuple of tensors for PyTorch tracing using flatten_to_tuple
rebuild_instances_from_flattened: rebuild detectron2 Instances objects from flattened tensor outputs using InstancesSchema
trace_model_with_adapter: trace a PyTorch model with rich inputs/outputs using TracingAdapter to flatten and rebuild
wrap_traced_model: create a wrapper function for a traced model that restores original input/output format using _create_wrapper
flatten_dict_to_tensors: flatten a dictionary with string keys into a tuple of tensors using DictSchema for tracing
